messages:
sam: Heads-up team — Im planning to start parental leave around 2026-08-01. Whats the latest I can file paperwork and still have benefits continued without a payroll hiccup?

mira (People Ops): Congrats, Sam! :tada: For benefits continuity we recommend submitting at least 2 weeks before your start date, but 4 weeks is ideal so payroll has time to process. Upload docs in the HR portal and select your caregiver status.

sam: Got it. Does Redwood require any specific doc naming convention? And do I need to request FMLA separately?

mira (People Ops): No strict file name needed, but put your name + leave-start in the filename (e.g., sam_parleave_20260801.pdf) — that helps our ops queue. FMLA is handled through the portals checkbox if youre eligible; we'll send the FMLA packet by email when you file.

jess: From a team perspective, can we split Sams on-call into two-week rotations? I can take the first two, Paul the next two. Also want a short indexed runbook.

paul: Fine by me. If Sam can highlight any in-flight customer escalations in the coverage plan that would help.

sam: I will add a "critical escalations" section and a 45-min handoff the week before. Also will pin the runbook in the repo.

mira (People Ops): Quick benefit notes: employer health contributions continue during approved leave; payroll deductions continue unless you opt out in the portal. Parental pay weeks depend on caregiver status — check your benefits summary after filing.

people-ops-bot: notice: "Upload supporting documentation to the HR portal to prevent payroll delays. Recommended deadline: 2026-07-18."

jess: Can Sam opt for a phased return? Say 60% for 4 weeks? How do we record that?

mira (People Ops): Yes — add "phased return request" in the notes when you submit. Manager approval is required; People Ops will coordinate a short RTW (return-to-work) plan. We'll also create a calendar reminder 2 weeks before return to confirm details.

sam: Thanks — last one: any paperwork for benefits continuation for my partner who will be on the company family plan?

mira (People Ops): If your partner is already on the plan, no extra form. If you're adding them due to birth/adoption, use the dependents form in benefits and upload the supporting docs within 30 days of the event to avoid losing coverage.

paul: I'll draft the rotation schedule and post it in the coverage plan section.

sam: Appreciate it all. Filing tonight and will DM you, Mira with the portal case number. :heart:
